control_failures.control_label: control of freeboard, beach width and decant

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: audit finding - change request not applied to HT-9001

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control IMPOUNDMENT_FREEBOARD_CONTROL: the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the control of freeboard, beach width and decant on HT-9001 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating an impoundment, specifically managing freeboard, beach and decant. HT-9001 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during routine operation while the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was in place but did not perform. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 28 July 2015 a planned field verification of HT-9001 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop found the control of freeboard, beach width and decant not effective.
